### P2 "PointCloud3D.1" (Render Pipeline) · Vertex

```glsl
// Reverse-Z (score project rule, CameraMath.hpp setReverseZPerspective): near -> NDC +1, far -> -1,
// paired with the engine's GREATER depth compare and 0.0 depth clear. A standard GL projection here
// makes the farthest fragment win.
mat4 buildPerspective(float fovDeg, float aspect, float near, float far)
{
  float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fovDeg) * 0.5);
  float nf = 1.0 / (near - far);
  return mat4(
    f / aspect, 0.0, 0.0,                   0.0,
    0.0,        f,   0.0,                   0.0,
    0.0,        0.0, -(far + near) * nf,    -1.0,
    0.0,        0.0, -2.0 * far * near * nf, 0.0
  );
}

mat4 buildLookAt(vec3 eye, vec3 target, vec3 up)
{
  vec3 f = normalize(target - eye);
  vec3 s = normalize(cross(f, up));
  vec3 u = cross(s, f);
```

### P2 "PointCloud3D.1" (Render Pipeline) · Fragment

description: Glowing 3D point cloud renderer with its own perspective camera (cameraPos looking at lookAt, fov in degrees). Draws every point of the incoming geometry as a soft Gaussian sprite (falloff sets how fast it fades toward the edge), coloured by the per-point color attribute (white when the geometry has none) times brightness, faded by opacity. Sprites are added onto what is below (additive: overlapp…; categories: Renderer, 3D; inputs: pointSize:float=5, opacity:float=1, falloff:float=4, brightness:float=1, sizeAttenuation:bool=true, cameraPos:point3D=[3,2,3], lookAt:point3D=[0,0,0], fov:float=60, nearPlane:float=0.01, farPlane:float=100

```glsl
void main()
{
  vec2 pc = gl_PointCoord * 2.0 - 1.0;
  float a = v_color.a * clamp(opacity, 0.0, 1.0) * exp(-dot(pc, pc) * falloff);
  if(a < 0.002)
    discard;

  isf_FragColor = vec4(v_color.rgb * brightness * a, a);
}
```

description: Add or replace the color attribute on geometry. Solid: solidColor. By Index: a rainbow along the vertex order (saturation). Random: a random hue per vertex (seed, saturation). Axis Gradient: colorA at -1 to colorB at +1 along gradientAxis (clamped outside). alpha multiplies the result.; categories: Geometry Modifier; resources: geo:geometry, colorMode:long, solidColor:color, colorA:color, colorB:color, seed:float, saturation:float, alpha:float, gradientAxis:long

```glsl
uint pcg(uint s)
{
  s ^= s >> 17u; s *= 0xed5ad4bbu;
  s ^= s >> 11u; s *= 0xac4c1b51u;
  s ^= s >> 15u; s *= 0x31848babu;
  s ^= s >> 14u;
  return s;
}

float rand01(uint s) { return float(pcg(s)) / 4294967296.0; }

// HSV to RGB
vec3 hsv2rgb(float h, float s, float v)
{
  vec3 c = vec3(h, s, v);
  vec3 p = abs(fract(c.xxx + vec3(1.0, 2.0/3.0, 1.0/3.0)) * 6.0 - 3.0);
  return c.z * mix(vec3(1.0), clamp(p - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0), c.y);
}
```
